items.title: Rust compilation, formatting and lint remain unexecuted
items.remaining: Resolve the genuine Cargo graph, run rustfmt/check/Clippy/tests on both targets after approval. Static source inspection is not parsing/type checking.

items.title: Windows filesystem/process/DPAPI behavior remains unverified
items.remaining: Test ACLs, reparse points, Job Object teardown, Windows canonical path variants, real special sockets, low disk and restore crash boundaries. No automatic cleanup should be trusted before this gate.

items.title: Path and executable identity checks are not atomic use operations
items.remaining: Same-user races between hash/identity checking and open/spawn/rename are not eliminated. Stronger handle-relative operations or a narrower threat model must be accepted; no OS isolation/exclusive-worktree claim.

items.title: Live vendor protocol/authentication/permission semantics remain unproved
items.remaining: Exercise exact installed Codex/Claude/ACP/Copilot versions, callbacks, failed launch and partial completion. Public schemas and fabricated fixtures cannot certify vendor behavior.

items.title: Unresolved dependency graph and transitive rustls advisory
items.remaining: No Cargo.lock exists. RUSTSEC-2026-0285 affects rustls >=0.23.13,<0.23.45. Determine actual linkage and audit the resolved graph. Do not assert this package is affected or fixed without resolution.

items.title: Secret protection is scoped, not end-to-end memory isolation
items.remaining: DPAPI protects at rest. Child programs can disclose injected secrets, same-user code can access them, and all intermediate copies are not guaranteed zeroized. Native secret canary/maximum-size/rotation/recovery tests remain mandatory.

items.title: Metadata freshness is not byte-identical content proof
items.remaining: Same-size edits with restored modification time can evade the existing handoff metadata digest. Receiving agents must independently inspect content/tests; stronger optional content evidence remains a design decision.

items.title: Failure injection and performance targets remain unmeasured
items.remaining: Interrupt real archive, repair, secret rotation and restoration after each effect step; test concurrent claims, huge input and low disk. No p95 latency or absolute recovery guarantee is claimed.

items.title: Code compression reduces human review reliability
items.remaining: Much of the inherited Rust is minified into long lines. Run a real rustfmt pass and review formatted diffs before certification; do not replace that with an improvised formatter.
